precepts.text: These are they that were not defiled with women. If our weakness is the woman, the 144, their weakness will not be woman.
precepts.point: A woman weakness is what? If our weakness is the woman, okay, that's why God says in Revelation 14, the 144, their weakness will not be woman. He says these are they that were not defiled with who?

note.label: The Decayed State of Liberal Women

precepts.why:
For the last sixty years a war has been waged on the black community, and Esau has been exploiting our weakness. What is the black man's weakness? The black woman. Peter calls her “the weaker vessel”: she is weaker than us. When Satan waged war against Adam, did he come and trick Adam? No. He went through Adam's weakness, the woman, to take Adam down. And the white man understands that too.

That is why God says of the 144 in Revelation 14, “These are they which were not defiled with women”. If our weakness is the woman, the 144's weakness will not be woman. They overcome the very place where Satan took Adam down.

And the woman's weakness is her emotions. She can be manipulated; the white man can trick her. Satan played with Eve's emotions, and she said the serpent beguiled me. Sisters, learn to control your emotions. In the house the sisters get in their feelings; that is their weakness, and our weakness is them.

We come down hard on the sisters because of the important role a woman plays in the nation. Y'all don't understand your importance, but our enemy does. He says, to destroy the black man I have to destroy the black woman first: make her a liberal, destroy the household, take the man out of it, make her think she doesn't need a man. The white man tricked you, sisters. So many problems in the black community come from no father in the house.

A strong woman and an independent woman are two different things. Our righteous foremothers were strong women: a strong woman builds her husband, keeps the family together, and uses her good job to help her family. An independent woman, the liberal woman, oppresses her husband, argues with him, won't listen to him, and ultimately leaves him seeking happiness. Your grandmother before the sixties was good, but the women from the 1960s until now, the majority of their minds are destroyed. The man who dwells with his wife according to knowledge must know where the weakness lies.

precepts.text: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication. Believe it or not, that great city is Babylon the great.
precepts.point: Where also our Lord was crucified. Brothers always skip over that part. Christ was crucified in Jerusalem. So what is it saying? That this is a spiritual Jerusalem, a figurative Jerusalem. It is not literal, but this is where our Lord was crucified. How so? We do not want that black Christ that taught the commandments to gather the twelve. We do not want that guy. Kill that. We want this European guy that came from France who loves everybody, that died for black people. That is what we want. That is also where our Lord was crucified.

note.label: Prison House of Shadows

precepts.why:
“the street of the great city”: which city? “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” Believe it or not, that great city is Babylon the great, the United States of America.

That great city is also the valley of dry bones of Ezekiel 37; it is speaking of the same thing. The prophet was set down “in the midst of the valley which was full of bones”, and “these bones are the whole house of Israel”, the twelve tribes, not the church people. So the valley is Babylon the great, and our dead bodies are those dry bones.

“which spiritually”: that is the key; not literally but figuratively. “is called Sodom”, because same-sex marriage is pushed here. “and Egypt”: a spiritual Egypt, with the all-seeing eye of Horus above the pyramid on your dollar bill and the obelisk in Washington DC, where the twelve tribes are held captive.

“where also our Lord was crucified.” Brothers always skip that part. Christ was crucified in Jerusalem, so this is a spiritual Jerusalem. How? We don't want that black Christ that taught the commandments to gather the twelve; kill that. We want the European guy from France who loves everybody and died for black people. That is how our Lord is crucified again in that great city.

precepts.text: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city. Babylon is that great city.
precepts.point: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city. What is the biblical name of the great city?

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”. What is the biblical name of the great city? Revelation tells us: “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city”. Babylon is that great city.

And Babylon the great is the United States of America. That is why Revelation 11:8 says it “spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt”. It isn't the real Sodom, but a spiritual Sodom: same-sex marriages here, transgenderism here, bestiality here, all kinds of filth. It isn't the real Egypt, but a spiritual Egypt: that's why the Egyptian pyramid is on the back of your dollar bill, with the all-seeing eye of Horus at the top, 1776 at the bottom, and the Latin for a new secular order, the new world order.

“where also our Lord was crucified”: it isn't the real Jerusalem, but a spiritual Jerusalem, because our people hate the real biblical Christ, that black Christ, and his teachings of the law. They want a white Jesus who teaches love for everybody: if it feels good, just do it. Remember they said we have no king but Caesar.

That great city is the “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”, “that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth”. The nation that reigns over the kings of the earth is the United States of America, not the Vatican. It is a mystery because the same place that destroyed us is the place that feeds us and gives us Medicaid, housing and education.

precepts.text: Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication. This place, America, is a spiritual Babylon; God calls it Babylon the great. So when Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar smote Moab, know that there is dual significance behind it.
precepts.point: On all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off. Moab shaves the hair in mourning, and it remains in their religions: definition read in class, in Chinese religious traditions head shaving is an absolute obligation for ordained monastics; in the Buddhist tradition the shaving of the head, the tonsure, carries significant meaning, and fully ordained monks and nuns must shave.

note.label: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People

precepts.why:
Revelation 11:8 speaks of “the great city.” Revelation 14 proves which city that is: “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.”

The great city is Babylon, the one that made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication. This place, America, is a spiritual Babylon. It is not the actual Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar, but this place God calls Babylon the great.

That is why we went there from Isaiah 15. Isaiah’s burden of Moab took place when Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar smote Moab: Ar of Moab and Kir of Moab, cities of Moab, “laid waste, and brought to silence” in the night. Moab went up to the high places to weep and howled over Nebo and Medeba, and “on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off”, because Moab shaves off its hair in great sorrow and mourning, a custom that remains in their religions to this day, in the head shaving of the monks and nuns of Chinese religion.

So when Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar smote Moab, know that there is dual significance behind it. There is a Babylon the great today, and Moab today is China, who with the Vietnamese and the Mongolians will be laid waste once again.

note.label: Member's In The Body

precepts.why:
Look at the back of your shirts, brothers. We have built this congregation, this body, on the faith in Christ and the commandments of God: “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

Is there any other way to build? Can you be successful any other way? No.

That is the foundation Paul says no man can lay other than Christ. For those in the Israelite camps who want to know the secret, the secret is keeping the laws, from the beginning. As long as we stand in the spirit, the Most High God is going to bless us and you'll see the growth. When another camp asked how we set up schools in different states and countries all over the world, the answer was: we keep the commandments and faith in Christ. The Lord is not going to bring the believers to you if you haven't been sent.

precepts.text: Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them. Your works are what follow you through those gates.
precepts.point: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief. Rest is entered by labour; that is the paradox the wilderness generation never accepted.

note.label: 70 Times 7: The Perfection of Mercy Through Christ

precepts.why:
“For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.” Revelation shows who rests and why: “Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.”

They rest from their labours, and their works follow them. Your works are what are going to allow you to enter in through those gates. The rest is not handed to the idle; it comes after the labour, and the labour goes with you into it.

So “Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief” that we read of in the wilderness. Labour in pain, bring forth your works, like the daughter of Zion in travail, and then rest from those labours in the kingdom.

precepts.text: These are they which were not defiled with women: not defiled with false doctrine and philosophy, and not defiled literally. These follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
precepts.point: The feast of firstfruits: count seven sabbaths complete from the wave offering, and number fifty days. Seven sabbaths again, complete.

note.label: 70 Times 7: The Perfection of Mercy Through Christ

precepts.why:
Revelation shows the firstfruits standing with Christ: “These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins.” Not defiled with philosophy, not defiled with false doctrine, and also not defiled with a literal woman.

“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.” They follow Christ wherever he goes, and they are redeemed from among men.

This is the end of the feast of firstfruits in Leviticus 23: Christ the firstfruits risen, and afterward those that are his, kept clean from the world’s doctrine and its filth, offered as “the firstfruits unto the Lord.”

precepts.text: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity and he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword; here is the patience and the faith of the saints, and that faith is revenge.
precepts.point: We love keeping God's commandments and teaching them to our people, and we despise evil; Deacon Ithan said we must have racial anger, and the enemy's destruction is our salvation.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.why:
Revelation 14:12 says, “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” What are we patiently waiting for? Verse 8 tells you: “Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” Babylon is America, and it is fallen, because of the wine of the wrath of her fornication: the death, the bodies, the souls, the slaves of our ancestors, and of our people to this day.

The scripture says we have to love the good and hate the evil. We are a love group: we love keeping God’s commandments and teaching them to our people. But we despise evil. Deacon Ithan said we have to have racial anger, and Wisdom of Solomon 18:7 shows the enemy’s destruction is our salvation.

So what is our faith? Revelation 13:10: “He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword.” Them that killed our people back then, and right now, and those that will slaughter us in the future, must be killed with the sword.

“Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.” What we just read is the patience and the faith of the saints, and that faith is revenge. Oppression maketh a wise man mad. That is how we tap back in: realizing that this destruction, the fall of Babylon, is our salvation.

precepts.text: Here are they that keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus: the commandments are the works and Jesus is the faith.
precepts.point: Abraham was justified by works when he offered Isaac; faith wrought with his works and by works was faith made perfect, and he was called the friend of God. By works a man is justified and not by faith only, as Romans 2:13 said, and Rahab was justified by works when she sent the spies out another way. As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

note.label: Navigating Through Paul's Letters: Works Of The Law & Liberty

precepts.why:
“shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.” You cannot show faith without works. You show your faith through your actions, which is keeping the commandments of God. John says it in Revelation: “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

Keep the commandments, and the faith of Jesus. The faith is one, and the commandments are the works. That is what James said, and what Ezra said: saved by works and by faith.

“Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.” Even the devils, the unclean spirits, believe in God and are afraid of him. “But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?” The vain man is the Christianity follower: faith without works, Calvinism, Protestantism, Catholicism. The saints are marked by both, the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus, and one without the other is dead.

precepts.text: They were redeemed from among men, the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
precepts.point: Paul espoused Israel as a chaste virgin to one husband, Christ.

note.label: Transforming from Immorality into Beautiful Civility Part 2

precepts.why:
“These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins.” That does not necessarily mean they are virgins physically. They are virgins in this truth. They put off the weak nature, the sins and the cares of the world. They are the ones that came in and repented, the new creature of 2 Corinthians 5:17, where old things are passed away and all things are become new.

“These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men”: redeemed from among the filth. To be redeemed means you were in the filth, in the vomit, at a serious deficit, and you had to be brought up out of it. We were redeemed from that, “being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.” We have been cleaned up for the Lord, men and women, so we have a chance and an opportunity to get it right.

“And in their mouth was found no guile”: no lies, “for they are without fault before the throne of God.” How can that be? Only when you are keeping the commandments of God and the faith of Christ.

So watch how you move. Replay your own actions in your mind, see how you are operating, and catch yourself, because there is an effort to take us off our path. The virgins who follow the Lamb keep the slate clean.

precepts.text: The saints keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus; commandments and faith go together.
precepts.point: The fathers in the wilderness had the gospel preached to them as we have: deliverance from captivity into the promised kingdom. But the word did not profit them, not being mixed with faith; they had the laws without the faith, and it is impossible to have one without the other.

note.label: Deuteronomy 1: The Second Giving of the Law

precepts.why:
“Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” Commandments and faith go together; the saints have both. Israel in the wilderness had the laws, but in this thing they did not believe the Lord their God, and the laws without the faith did not bring them into the land.

It is impossible to have one without the other. Keeping the commandments without believing the Lord who gave them is what the fathers did, and the word did not profit them. The saints keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus, and that faith is what the fathers lacked when they would not believe the God who went before them in fire and cloud.

precepts.text: Here is the patience of the saints: they keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus, not the bow or the gun.
precepts.point: Israel's forefathers died only when the Most High said it was time; that is the only way any of them died. David mourned Jonathan, saying his love to him was wonderful, passing the love of women.

note.label: 2 Samuel 1: David Laments Saul and Jonathan

precepts.why:
“Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” That is how Israel fights in the last days: with the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus, not the bow or the gun.

David taught the children of Judah the use of the bow in his day, but the redemption of Israel does not come by force of arms. This is spiritual war and not physical, and the saints hold it with patience, keeping the commandments and the faith.

precepts.text: Here is the patience and the faith of the saints, for we endure to the end just as Job endured his trial.
precepts.point: The purpose of the trial was to see whether Job would fix himself and stay faithful or curse the Most High. The same thing happens to us: we endure to the end as Job did, and at some point the Most High will turn the captivity of the Israelites who kept the commandments and repay them for all their righteousness, far more than double the houses, families, cars, and jobs we have now, giving us much more in the kingdom.

note.label: Job 42: The Lord Turned the Captivity of Job

precepts.why:
“Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” Job endured his trial, and we endure to the end as Job did, keeping the commandments and the faith.

The same thing happens to us. At some point the Most High will turn the captivity of the Israelites who kept the commandments and repay them for all their righteousness, far more than double the houses, families, cars, and jobs we have now, giving us much more in the kingdom, just as he blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning.
